Led Zeppelin - The Song Remains The Same (1976/2018) Blu-ray Audio



Celebrated Live Album's Debut Release On Blu-Ray Audio Disc!
Newly Remastered Audio Supervised By Jimmy Page!
Entire Album In 5.1 Surround & Stereo High-Resolution Audio!
The Blu-Ray configuration includes 96kHz/24 bit 5.1 (DTS-HD Master Audio Surround) and stereo mixes (PCM Stereo and DTS-HD Master Audio Stereo), and video performances of four songs not in the original film: "Celebration Day", "Over The Hills And Far Away", "Misty Mountain Hop" and "The Ocean".
